# Matching engine corresponding-source delivery

This app uses the source-built FFmpeg/ffprobe 9.0 pair. The matching source archive supplied alongside the app is:

`MediaForge-engine-source-9.0.tar.gz`

SHA-256: `1b4d15c7935089f2890881e2caccaeda67898449c842a5463112470a827be10d`

Distributors must keep this matching archive accessible with the app and preserve the license notices. It contains all pinned engine/library source tarballs, build recipes and build records. See README.md and the GPL texts for obligations; this record is not a blanket legal or patent clearance.
